query: What drives customer satisfaction (Overall Rating) across the different airlines?

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: A qualitative categorization of crew/staff service extracted from reviews. It lies outside the overall rating, is not a deterministic function of it, and plausibly carries strong predictive signal about satisfaction. Note some redundancy with existing 'Staff Service' column, but it adds granularity.

per_column.name: meal_quality_consistency
per_column.rationale: Categorical assessment of food/meal experience derived from review text. Distinct from the outcome, plausibly predictive of overall satisfaction, though it partly overlaps with the existing 'Food & Beverages' column.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_adequacy
per_column.rationale: Categorical seat comfort description drawn from reviews. It is an antecedent driver of satisfaction, not a restatement of the rating; predictive despite overlap with existing 'Seat Comfort'.

per_column.name: ground_operations
per_column.rationale: Captures check-in/boarding/ground handling quality, a dimension NOT already present in the original columns. Legitimate external predictor with plausible signal and genuine novelty beyond the base schema.

per_column.name: customer_service_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Responsiveness of customer service, an antecedent experience factor not directly in the original schema. Legitimate predictor with plausible signal, distinct from the outcome.

judge.rationale: All five columns are legitimate, non-leaking antecedent drivers of satisfaction extracted from the review text; none restate or are deterministic functions of overall_rating, and none are post-outcome. As a set they carry real predictive signal. However, three of them (crew_service_quality, meal_quality_consistency, seat_comfort_adequacy) substantially duplicate existing structured columns (Staff Service, Food & Beverages, Seat Comfort), so their MARGINAL leverage beyond the original table is modest. Ground_operations and customer_service_responsiveness add genuinely new dimensions, which lifts the incremental utility to a moderate level.
